chapter: Producing, state of New Orleans music
title: Local artists and current projects
summary: He talks about older musicians, current studio artists, and his planned album and writing for Wayne Cochran.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And the theory is that some of the radio stations were heard in Jamaica and that they picked up on some of the early sounds. It's hard to hear it today, but that's how the theory goes. Do you have trouble working with some of the, or do you find it difficult to work with some of the older local musicians in trying to produce them here? And trying to be more specific with that. Trying to find the right sound for them, trying to not get too far away from the old sound, because you don't want to just do the old music, but guiding them, because they've all had hits, but maybe they need direction, or some of them need direction.
Yeah. Because, I mean, you have a lot of local musicians in town who are big in the 50s on their own. And do you find it hard to kind of guide them towards the right thing?
I'm not really up against that. Mm-hmm. I haven't been lately, so I can't take that on as to whether it would be a problem or not.

But, okay, well, I guess it hasn't been. Errol King's in here pretty often, isn't he? Right. He's working on an album with George Porter, if I'm not mistaken. Yes. We play Bigfoot. George Lottis played Bigfoot on a show we had in the meters. That sounds really great. Something that we'll probably be listening to in 20 years from now. Who are some of the other artists that are in the studio, or have been in the studio recently?

Wayne Cochran. Wayne Cochran. I haven't taken anyone in myself in months, deliberately. But there's been a lot of the artists around here, like Lee Bates. They've been going in and out. Many times I don't know.
Are you, or are you personally involved in right now? Are you working on an album yourself?
Well, I'm writing for Brown and Bryant right now. A couple of things for Wayne Cochran is going to be back. And an album for myself.
When do you envision the album that you're doing coming up?
Well, I'm going to do four sides first. So I'll be doing that within this month sometime, some way. Around and about Brown and Bryant and Wayne Cochran.
Mm-hmm. Or somebody asked me if you'd have the thematic piece sail on on your new album.
